name: Mamata Pattnaik/ ମମତା ପଟ୍ଟନାୟକ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Mamata Pattnaik writes poetry in Odia, alongside stories, reviews and essays on language and literature. Srujan’s 2021 contributor note places her in Bhubaneswar and records a writing life that extends from literary periodicals to programmes on All India Radio and Doordarshan. Her poem ‘Shabda’ appeared in that journal, considering the creative and destructive possibilities of words.

In Kabita Live’s ‘ଉପେକ୍ଷାର ଋତୁ’, broken trust becomes a landscape of shattered images, fire and scars. The speaker answers estrangement by gathering the pieces of the self, turning away from the contest of defeating others. The poem’s movement towards rebuilding gives its anger and hurt a quietly resolute ending.
